_doc: Desert decorations (bead bzc.88, docs/art/classes/decorations.md): passable small details at 32 x 32 with the doodad class layer, impassable props on 64 x 64 (one cell) or 128 x 64 (two cells side by side) with the prop class layer. generate-image-v2, no style image, like set decorations; one call returns many candidates of a mixed subject, the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one tiny sand desert detail, each image a different one of these: a round dry tumbleweed ball of tangled pale brown twigs #b08a5a, a small shiny blue-green scarab beetle #2f7a7a, a bleached ox skull with two short curved horns #e8dcc0, a tuft of dry yellow desert grass #c8a85a, a little desert flower with three pink #e07aa0 blossoms on a grey-green stem, a tiny round barrel cactus #5f8a4a with a yellow flower. Small and low, about half of the image wide, much smaller than a person.
recipes.negative: sand patch, ground, shadow, person, gold, coins, gem, chest, pot
